title: Adaptive Sensor Weighting for Tactical Spatial Attribution (Section 3.3 reference implementation)
description: Single-file C++17 reference implementation of Section 3.3 (Adaptive Sensor Weighting) of a dissertation on hybrid Bayesian tactical spatial identification of Wi-Fi signal sources. Implements the product-form normalized weight w_s = m_s · π_s · γ_s · κ_s · ρ_s (eq. 3.1) with the four canonical quality components (provenance, geometric informativeness via a log-det Fisher-information increment, calibration validity, completeness), constrained projection onto the policy-admissible set (eq. 3.5), trust-domain caps, rate limiter, hysteresis, emergency exclusion, a full weight trace and machine-readable reason codes. No external dependencies; runs as-is on OnlineGDB. Operating points are declared to_be_validated. Analytical illustration, not empirical data.
